mythVsFact.myth: A travel health consultation is the same as a quick vaccination appointment.
mythVsFact.fact: Full travel health consultations review itinerary, medical history and all health risks — vaccination is one component of broader planning.

mythVsFact.myth: Pharmacist prescribers can treat any condition a GP can.
mythVsFact.fact: Independent prescribing scope is defined by training, competence and clinical governance — not all conditions are suitable for pharmacy prescribing.
